module: "Side curves" checkpoint marker: a ground base (checkpoint_curve_base.dae), active side curves (checkpoint_curve_active.dae, or _finish for lap and final) and a "distant" version (checkpoint_curve_distant.dae) that fades in when far away (switches between 50 m and 75 m by default). Oriented along the checkpoint normal or the camera. The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/sideMarker')(id) gives an object of class C.
notes: Colors per mode: default red (1, 0.07, 0), next black, start and lap green (0.4, 1, 0.2), final blue (0.1, 0.3, 1), branch orange (1, 0.6, 0), hidden black. Mode change with a 0.3 s color fade.
setToCheckpoint(wp) reads wp.pos, wp.radius, wp.normal (optional), wp.fadeNear, wp.fadeFar, wp.mode (model choice).
The near/far switch lasts 0.8 s (blendDuration) with hysteresis between fadeNear and fadeFar.
The self.sides field and the C:hide/C:show functions use stored colors (oldColor/newColor) that update never reads: leftover code.
The extracted page shows update(dtSim); the actual signature is update(dt, dtSim).

init.desc: Constructor: initializes the state and copies the mode table.

update.desc: Per-frame call: handles the near/far fade, the rotation toward the normal or the camera, the colors and the alpha of the base, the sides and the distant version.

setToCheckpoint.desc: Places base, sides and distant marker on a checkpoint.

setMode.desc: Changes mode: shows (except 'hidden'), starts the color fade and changes the sides' model.

mode.desc: default, next, start, lap, final, branch or hidden.

setVisibility.desc: Shows or hides the three objects.

createObject.desc: Creates a hidden TSStatic registered under objectName and added to ScenarioObjectsGroup.

createMarkers.desc: Removes the old objects then creates base, sides and distant version.
